entities.summary: Nicklas Kulti is a former professional tennis player from Sweden. He was born in Stockholm. His career-high rankings were World No. 32 in singles in 1993, and No. 11 in doubles in 1997. Kulti was ranked No. 1 in the junior singles rankings in 1989. Nicklas Kulti was a athletes & competitors from Stockholm (b. 1971-04-22, Stockholm). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
